standard.summary: 当前后端仅消费 block（整块重算）。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.block: 整 block 重算（现在后端就吃这个）。
optionDescriptions.selective: 选择性重算:只挑一部分算子存激活,比整块重算多占一点显存、少花一点时间;这条路不被支持时会退回最近的安全档。

standard_en.summary: The backend currently consumes only block (recomputing whole blocks).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.block: Recomputes the whole block (this is what the backend takes today).
optionDescriptions.selective: Selective recomputation: only some operators keep their activations, which costs a little more VRAM than recomputing the whole block and a little less time; when this path is not supported it falls back to the nearest safe gear.

advanced.principle: 当前后端仅消费 block（整块重算）。保留字段便于与 Anima 对齐及后续扩展。

advanced_en.principle: The backend currently only consumes block (full-block recompute). The field is kept for alignment with Anima and future extensions.
